game_title: Function Test Arena – Ice Market Streak
game_concept: A quiz RPG set in Snowy Hold – Ice Market, a market under icicles: the snow ranger must handle blizzard sprites while practicing functions. Core idea – Function Test Arena: Write quick assert tests to confirm functions behave before facing blizzard sprites.
theme: Snowy Hold – Ice Market: a market under icicles
core_gameplay_loop: In Ice Market, repeat each round: Write quick assert tests to confirm functions behave before facing blizzard sprites. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the tests_passed value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 13 consecutive correct decisions about tests_passed to power up the snow ranger and open the hold gate.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 9 (extended tier): Function Test Arena
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Function Test Arena' (Week 6 slot 13), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Ice Market'. tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how tests_passed changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against blizzard sprites in Ice Market.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 13.
